response.justification: Candidate meets minimum experience requirements with 20 years in software engineering and a BS in Computer Science. Current role at re:cinq shows recent engagement with AI infrastructure through MCP tooling. However, this director-level principal engineer position requires deep AI strategic expertise and demonstrated platform vision. The candidate's AI experience is limited to 16 months of infrastructure work, lacks an advanced AI degree, shows no evidence of building recognized AI products or platforms, and lacks demonstrated experience advising on cloud/AI strategy—all critical for this role.
strengths: Over 20 years of software engineering experience across diverse platforms (web, mobile, embedded, infrastructure) demonstrating strong technical breadth
Currently engaged with AI infrastructure at re:cinq working on MCP frameworks and agentic workflows, showing recent exposure to cutting-edge AI systems
Demonstrates entrepreneurial initiative and commitment to knowledge-sharing through founding GISCollective and creating technical workshops
concerns: Very limited AI/ML expertise despite preferred and implicit role requirements; only ~16 months of AI infrastructure work with no demonstrated AI products or platforms
Lacks Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field and shows no evidence of 'recognized expertise in AI' as preferred in job description
No demonstrated experience with strategic platform vision, cloud architecture strategy, or advising strategic customers/partners on AI adoption as required at principal engineer level

key_factors.factor: Recent AI infrastructure work at re:cinq
